name: Warracker
description: Warracker is a self-hosted warranty tracker. Keep track of all your warranties, receipts, and manuals in one place — with expiry notifications, document storage (local or Paperless-ngx), tags, claims, and CSV import/export. REQUIRES PostgreSQL: install a PostgreSQL container first (e.g. the official postgres template), create a database and user, then point DB_HOST/DB_NAME/DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD below at it.

paths.name: Uploads
paths.description: Persistent storage for uploaded invoices, manuals, and photos.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the Warracker web interface (container listens on 80).

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: PostgreSQL host. Install a PostgreSQL container first, then use its IP address (find it under Docker -> container -> IP) or container name.

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Secret key for Flask sessions and JWT. Generate a random string (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32).

variables.name: FRONTEND_URL
variables.description: Public URL of the frontend (used for redirects).

variables.name: APP_BASE_URL
variables.description: Public base URL of the application (used in email links).

variables.name: SMTP_HOST
variables.description: SMTP host for password resets and notifications (optional).

variables.name: WARRACKER_MEMORY_MODE
variables.description: Memory profile: optimized (default), ultra-light, or performance.
